title: 第2章 连着十天无休！
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋云初竟敢这样称呼他！

可他分明就没见宋云初张嘴。

他不过才喝了两三杯果酒，他能够确认自己是清醒的，绝不可能出现幻觉。

四目相对之际，他见宋云初面带疑惑地又唤了他一声，“陛下？”

【狗皇帝刚才那一眼好犀利，难道是在盘算着要对付我？不应该吧，按照原著的时间线，他和我还没到撕破脸的时候。】

君离洛：“……！”

他从惊愕中回过神来，已确认了一个事实。

宋云初只说了陛下二字，周遭的人也没有特别的反应，他后边听到的那些对他大不敬的话，是宋云初的心声！

宋云初还在等他接话，他平复着心中的惊涛骇浪，面色如常地开口：“朕方才见你一直盯着前头的歌姬看，莫不是喜欢那女子？你若喜欢，朕就把她赐给你。”

“陛下，微臣方才只是在想一些事，并非是对那姑娘有意。”宋云初连忙拒绝，“微臣谢过陛下的好意，您日理万机，无需为这点小事费心。”

【狗皇帝私下培植了不少密探，放在宫中各个部门充当眼线，这唱曲的小妞莫非也是密探之一？啧，反正拒绝就对了。】

君离洛再次听到了宋云初心中所想，举着酒杯的手顿了顿，而后淡然一笑，“朕只是随口问问，云初不喜欢，朕自然不勉强。”

宋云初回以假笑，转回身时，又是一阵腹诽。

【狗皇帝演戏的本事可真不赖，外表斯文俊秀，让人看不出他憋着坏。】

【他刚才的眼神究竟是什么意思呢？】

【算了，走一步看一步，想办法别让他黑化，我就不信了我改不了结局。】

宋云初自然是不知，身后的君离洛正望着她的背影，满腹疑云。

宋云初的心声里，有些他不太能理解的词，他好奇，却不能问出口。

宋云初知他一直以来都在装模作样，也知他在等一个将其铲除的时机。既然宋云初不拆穿他，他自然也乐意将君臣和睦的戏码继续演下去。

宋云初啊宋云初，你仗着拥立之功，言行不端，对朕毫不敬畏，更无忠诚，如今朕能听到你心中所想，你若敢犯上作乱，朕定会有应对之策，你永远不可能凌驾于朕之上。

一个藏不住心思的人，注定一败涂地！

之后的日子里，君离洛对宋云初依旧如从前那般器重信任，常在下朝之后将宋云初叫到御书房陪他处理政务。

他自然是为了多听听宋云初的心声。

起初他还在担心，他忽然拥有的这项能力会不会很快就消失，但一晃眼十天过去，每每和宋云初相处，他都能听见对方心中所想，他也就不再多虑。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

How dare Song Yunchu call him that!

But he clearly didn't see Song Yunchu open his mouth.

He had only drank two or three glasses of fruit wine, and he could confirm that he was awake and that there was no way he was hallucinating.

When their eyes met, he saw Song Yunchu calling him again with doubts on his face, "Your Majesty?"

[The Dog Emperor’s look just now was so sharp, was he planning to deal with me?It shouldn’t be. According to the timeline of the original work, he and I haven’t broken up yet.】

Jun Liluo: "...!"

He recovered from his shock and confirmed a fact.

Song Yunchu only said the word "Your Majesty", and the people around him had no special reaction. The disrespectful words he heard later were Song Yunchu's inner voice!

Song Yunchu was still waiting for him to answer. He calmed down the turmoil in his heart and said with a normal expression: "I just saw you staring at the singer in front of you. Do you like that woman? If you like her, I will give her to you."

"Your Majesty, Wei Chen was just thinking about something, and he did not have any intention for the girl." Song Yunchu refused quickly, "Wei Chen thanked Your Majesty for your kindness. You have so many things to do, so there is no need to worry about this little thing."

[The Dog Emperor has secretly cultivated many spies and placed them in various departments in the palace to act as spies. Is this girl singing the song one of the spies?Tsk, just refuse anyway.】

Jun Liluo once again heard what Song Yunchu was thinking. He paused with his hand holding the wine glass, and then smiled lightly, "I'm just asking casually. If Yunchu doesn't like it, I won't force it."

Song Yunchu responded with a fake smile, but when he turned around, he cursed again.

[The Dog Emperor is really good at acting, and his appearance is gentle and handsome, making it hard for people to tell that he is holding back his bad intentions.】

[What did the look in his eyes mean just now?】

[Forget it, take it one step at a time and try to find a way to prevent him from becoming evil. I don’t believe it anymore. I can’t change the ending.】

Song Yunchu naturally didn't know that Jun Liluo behind her was looking at her back, full of doubts.

There were some words in Song Yunchu's heart that he didn't quite understand. He was curious but couldn't ask.

Song Yunchu knew that he had been pretending all along, and also knew that he was waiting for an opportunity to eradicate him.Since Song Yunchu didn't expose him, he was naturally willing to continue the drama of harmony between monarch and ministers.

Song Yunchu, Song Yunchu, relying on your support, you have misbehaved and have no respect for me, let alone loyalty. Now I can hear what you are thinking. If you dare to cause trouble, I will definitely have a countermeasure. You can never be above me.

A person who cannot hide his thoughts is destined to fail!

In the days that followed, Jun Liluo still valued and trusted Song Yunchu as much as before, and often called Song Yunchu to the imperial study room to accompany him to handle government affairs after the court.

Naturally, he wanted to hear more of Song Yunchu's thoughts.

At first, he was still worried whether the ability he suddenly possessed would disappear soon, but ten days passed in the blink of an eye. Whenever he got along with Song Yunchu, he could hear what the other person was thinking, and he no longer worried about it.
